answer: A market grading sonnet translations or ledge surveys can admit reviewers through fresh hidden calibration tasks. Mix independently verified test cases into ordinary assignments, commit the reference labels before grading, and award earning access only after sustained accuracy. Even at the zenith of enrollment, new keys receive no automatic reviewer reward. A farm must solve a separate unpredictable test stream for every paid seat; copying one answer across aliases fails on different instances. Leaked labels and cheap specialist solvers weaken the cost barrier.
